heroAlt: Kings International - where traditional craft meets modern technology

theHouse.heading: A vertically integrated house, built on leather.
theHouse.intro: Founded in 1977 in Kanpur, the heart of India's leather industry, Kings International Ltd. has become a leader in premium leather craftsmanship, from raw hide to finished product, cut and stitched under one roof.
theHouse.imageAlt: Hides drying at the Kings International in-house tannery, Kanpur

stats.heading: From raw hide to finished order, vertically integrated.

process.title: Raw Hide
process.body: Hides tanned and hung to dry.

process.title: Drying & Sorting
process.body: Dried, sorted and staged for cutting.

process.title: Cutting & Production
process.body: Cut, stitched and assembled on the line.

process.title: Finished Order
process.body: Inspected, packed and ready to ship.

whyChooseUs.heading: Crafting excellence. Delivering trust.
whyChooseUs.intro: At Kings International, we don't just manufacture leather products - we build long-term business partnerships.

reasons.title: Proven Expertise
reasons.copy: 48+ years of hands-on leather craftsmanship, since 1977.

reasons.title: Premium Materials
reasons.copy: Full-grain buffalo, goat and European cow hides, selected and tanned in-house.

reasons.title: Custom Solutions
reasons.copy: Private label and OEM development, built around your specification.

reasons.title: Customer-First Approach
reasons.copy: A direct line to the export desk - not a call centre.

reasons.title: Global Partnerships
reasons.copy: Trusted by brands, wholesalers and importers across three continents.

reasons.title: Vertically Integrated
reasons.copy: Hide to finished product, cut and stitched under one roof.

reasons.title: Export Experience
reasons.copy: Corporate office in Kanpur, plus an overseas subsidiary in the United Kingdom.

reasons.title: Ethical Practices
reasons.copy: Traceable sourcing and fair labour, audited to SA 8000.

reasons.title: Sustainability Commitment
reasons.copy: Zero-liquid-discharge tannery, solar power and water recycling since 2015.

collection.heading: Five house brands, one factory floor.
